import importlib.util, json, random, sys, io, contextlib

def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod

main = load("mysub", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
brute = load("brute", "/workspace/tmp/brute.py")
gen2 = load("gen2", "/workspace/tmp/gen2.py")

def run_main(obj):
    buf = io.StringIO()
    old = sys.stdin
    class S:  # minimal stdin shim
        buffer = None
    sys.stdin = S()
    S.buffer = io.BytesIO(json.dumps(obj).encode())
    r = main.main()
    sys.stdin = old
    return r, buf

def run_main_text(text):
    class S: pass
    S.buffer = io.BytesIO(text.encode())
    old = sys.stdin
    sys.stdin = S
    buf = io.StringIO()
    try:
        code = main.main()
    finally:
        sys.stdin = old
    return code, buf.getvalue()

start = int(sys.argv[1]); stop = int(sys.argv[2])
bad = 0
for seed in range(start, stop):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    obj = gen2.gen(rng)
    if obj is None:
        continue
    try:
        got = main.solve(obj)
    except main.Invalid:
        continue
    exp = brute.run(obj)
    if got != exp:
        bad += 1
        print("MISMATCH seed", seed)
        print(json.dumps(obj))
        json.dump(got, open("/workspace/tmp/got.json","w"))
        json.dump(exp, open("/workspace/tmp/exp.json","w"))
        if bad > 3: break
print("checked, mismatches:", bad)
